title_en: The Moon's eye and the lunar phases
Revenge on the Moon for informing
description_en: Person tries to eclipse the Moon because the Moon told about his crime.
The Sun and the Moon are or were, permanently or from time to time, on hostile terms.
The Sun is associated with a rider or rides in a cart drawn by horses (equids).
The Sun or the Moon rides across the sky in a cart or a sledge.

title_en: One carries the Sun, another the Moon
A parrot shone before the sun
description_en: Before the sun appeared, the world was lit by a big brightly coloured bird (a parrot or a toucan).
There was a time when several, i.e. more than two, suns shone in the sky simultaneously.
The moon is an object that its owners let go by chance or that was stolen from them and so got to the sky.

title_en: Who is first in the calendar?
description_en: Animals argue which of them should open the cycle of twelve months or years. The mouse gets the first place.

title_en: Who gets up first has the better voice
Sun and Moon: the clever and the foolish
description_en: The smart Sun-man involves the foolish Moon in various tricks which the Moon is unable to invent himself. Trying to repeat the Sun's actions, the Moon fails. Cf. motif B1F.

title_en: Destructive heat comes from the sun
description_en: The world was or will be (almost) burned when several suns appeared or will appear simultaneously; or destructive heat (or light) once came from a single sun.

title_en: The moon shone like the sun
description_en: At first the moon was as bright and hot as the sun.
The Sun is going to have children. One of the animals warns that if the Sun has children, the world will burn. The Sun has to (give up marriage and) remain childless.
The catastrophe that threatens the earth is related to the appearance not only of several suns but also of several moons.

title_en: Sun and Moon are severed heads
description_en: The sun and/or the moon are severed heads of anthropomorphic beings.
A woman sits down (jumps) on the face (back) of the Moon-man and is now seen in the lunar spots.

title_en: Man with a pitchfork in the moon
description_en: A man with a pitchfork in his hands is seen in the lunar spots.

title_en: The headless one in the moon
description_en: A headless man is seen on the lunar disc.
A silhouette of a certain person is seen on the solar disc. Or it is told that a person got to the sun and remained there.

title_en: Sun or moon is an animal

description_en: A criminal tries to make the moon dim because its light irritates him or prevents him from committing crimes.
The Sun is contrasted with people as an immortal with mortals; it is responsible for people being mortal.
Person shoots an arrow into the sky trying to hit a luminary or a deity but the arrow hits an obstacle that screened the target.
Each of the calendar units that make up a year (usually months) is imagined as a particular object or being.

title_en: The sun's imitator falls from the sky
description_en: Having ascended to the sky, person plays the part of the sun unsuccessfully and as a result falls or is thrown down to the earth.

title_en: Sun and moon are a deity's eyes
description_en: The sun and the moon (Rigveda: only the sun) are associated with the eyes of an anthropomorphic being (the motif of their origin from the eyes of this being can be absent).

title_en: The sun is born from an egg
description_en: The sun is born or emerges from an egg.

title_en: The sun in the world of the dead
description_en: After setting below the horizon, the sun shines for the anthropomorphic inhabitants of the lower world: the dead, dwarfs, etc.
Clouds are associated with cattle, especially with cows (and rain is their milk).

title_en: A woman turns into a woodpecker
description_en: A woman refuses to share her bread with Jesus who came to her, and he turns her into a woodpecker.
In the past the people had writing and knowledge but lost them, or the people missed the opportunity to obtain them.

title_en: The magic wife's husband turns into a rooster
description_en: A woman of non-human nature agrees to live with a man but abandons him after learning of his real or supposed unfaithfulness.
In the beginning of time or during the flood the mammoth drowned or sank into the ground; since then there are no mammoths on earth.
A river bed follows the track of a snake, fish, dragon or crab; a river emerges from parts of a snake's body; a river is a snake.

title_en: Winter sleep of the snotty ones
description_en: There are beings who sleep in winter with frozen snot hanging from their noses. (The motif was singled out by Evgenia Korovina).

title_en: A little bird wants to fill up the sea
description_en: A small bird carries pebbles and sticks trying to fill up the sea.
Birds (cranes or storks, geese or crows) carry children to the other world or bring them from there. See motif H6c3, "The stork and the other world".

title_en: A fly instead of a nail
description_en: A fly sits down on the breast of the crucified Jesus. The persecutors who intended to drive a nail into his heart do not do it because they think that the nail is already there.
Ever since a piece of flesh was torn off the human foot, there is a hollow between the toes and the heel.

Animals (more rarely plants) have or lack certain organs, and these organs have their peculiarities, because in the time of creation one species exchanged them with another or borrowed another's organ and refused to return it. In some cases a reverse exchange and a return to the initial state are described, as well as one animal giving a part of its body to another without compensation. A man or a deity can take the place of one of the animals.

title_en: The nightingale and the slow worm
description_en: The nightingale (more rarely somebody else) takes the eyes of the slow worm and does not return them; the slow worm remains blind.

title_en: Going to a feast, borrows another's organ
description_en: A zoomorphic person goes to a feast and asks another to lend him a body part with which he would look more attractive.
Formerly the beaver had a tail like the muskrat has now, and the muskrat had a tail like that of the beaver.

title_en: Two brothers: the winner and the loser
description_en: In the time of creation two men have a common origin, are not antagonists and show their particular traits acting in a series of episodes. One is clever and successful, the other is simple-minded and irresponsible.

Four brothers change the world ridding it of monsters, transforming its inhabitants and obtaining valuables (water, fire, cultivated plants, etc.). Usually one of the brothers is the leader and the others help him. All four often share one name.
Persons consider what would be the best thing to turn into and decide to become thunder and/or lightning.
Persons consider what would be the best thing to turn into and decide to become a star object.
A person cannot bury a dead one, not knowing how to do it or finding no place for the burial.

(While there is no earth yet or it has not hardened) a bird buries the dead in its own body, usually in its beak or head, which explains the unpleasant smell or the origin of the crest, of a swelling on the beak, etc.
Person carries the body of a dead one for a long time being unable to bury it or not knowing how to do it, but eventually buries the body in the ground.
Adversaries of a hero who travels by sea turn into seals or dolphins.

title_en: Days of the week are (demonic) persons
description_en: In narrative folklore the days of the week (most often Friday and Wednesday) are particular (female) persons of a more or less pronounced demonic nature.
It is said about the most severe cold that it can freeze boiling water, an embryo in its mother's womb, etc.
It is said about the strength of the cold in early spring that it breaks the horns of a big ungulate.
Performing certain actions, an (old) woman determines the cycle of day and night.

title_en: Going for fire, the hero ties up an old woman
description_en: At night the fire goes out. A youth goes in search of fire and on his way ties up an old woman or an old man (usually the person responsible for the length of night and day).
The Sun has a mother who lives with him (more rarely with her) in one house. Cf. motif K27x6a ("A person comes to the sun's mother").
Birds, fish and quadrupeds deliberately or accidentally smear themselves with coloring substances or divide between themselves parts of another creature's body and as a result get their present look.

title_en: Living beings are given their appearance
description_en: A person decorates different birds (more rarely fish), distributes fat among animals. Since then the corresponding species have their present features.
Two quadrupeds (or a quadruped and another creature) decorate each other or somebody decorates them.

title_en: A reddish star is an arrow
description_en: A big reddish star (Betelgeuse or Aldebaran) is identified with an arrow.
Orion is related to the cosmic hunt story. (Motifs b42h, b42h1, b42m, b42r included).
The three main stars of the handle of the Big Dipper are associated with people of three different nationalities.

title_en: The stars of the Dipper's handle are three persons
description_en: The stars of the handle of the Big Dipper are three people, and the four stars of the dipper are animals or objects (one or several).
A person is created of many materials or objects or of a material brought from different places.

The first ancestors (usually birds or animals) argue with each other about the length of the units of time in the calendar or daily cycle or about whether the cold and dark or the warm and light time should prevail. See motif B44.
In the argument whether there should be light (warmth) in the world the bear is on the side of darkness (and cold); or the world is in darkness because the bear hides the sun in his house.
A fish strikes against the land chipping islands off the mainland.

title_en: He who tried to frighten God
description_en: A person who tried to frighten God (people) by his looks, behaviour or sudden appearance is turned for this into an animal (of a guise different from his former one).

title_en: Blood of the fleeing colours objects
description_en: Children run after their mother and hurt themselves; their blood colours plants, earth, the evening sky.

title_en: Wings made of a cutting board
description_en: A woman makes herself wings (a beak, a tail) of the tools used for making clothes and turns into a bird or a flying squirrel.

title_en: Sounds of the creation time: the voice of wife or mother-in-law
description_en: Person pushes his mother-in-law or wife into a tree hollow; she turns into the creaking of trees or into echo.

title_en: To put a pancake on the sky
description_en: Formerly or in a distant land the sky was or is so low that people put various objects on it when they need to.

title_en: To get the moon from the sky
description_en: People try to climb to the sky to get the moon. (In brackets: traditions in which the moon is the aim of building a tower to the sky but there is no task to get it).
Alcor (a weak star near the second star of the handle of the Big Dipper) is a baby.
A person who has become blind asks another to lend him his eyes or to exchange eyes and keeps the eyes for himself.
To punish his own buttocks for wrong behaviour, the trickster burns them.
The Bat becomes an outcast among other creatures (usually after trying to join now the beasts and now the birds).
The Bat comes into conflict with other creatures in connection with somebody's death or funeral.

title_en: The bat deceived by a deity
description_en: The sky deity could have cured the bat's mother or child but did not do it and they died.
All people or particular ethnic groups, lineages or families are considered descendants of a dog (with which a man had intercourse).

title_en: The rooster lures the sun out
description_en: The cock lures out the sun that has hidden itself, or people think that the sun will not rise without the cock's crow.

title_en: Not to spill a drop of urine
description_en: Person agrees that his place will be soiled with excrements but only on condition that not a drop of urine is spilled. It proves impossible to fulfil this condition.
The owl proves to be more intelligent and wiser than other living beings.
The bat proves to be more intelligent and wiser than other living beings.
Demonic beings will build a ship from nail parings.
Every day a bird of prey comes to a chained person and pecks at his inner organs. In a day the person recovers and everything is repeated.
The flood begins after people kill (offend, maim) some (usually aquatic) creature.
A frog (toad) prevents more than one sun from shining in the sky.

title_en: The flood: rescue on a tree
description_en: During the flood those who climbed a tree are saved.

Birds must dive to bring from the bottom the earth from which the dry land will emerge. The loon cannot reach the bottom, refuses to dive or tries to conceal the earth it has brought (usually it is punished for this).

title_en: The loon is the successful diver
description_en: The loon dives and brings a bit of earth (grass, etc.) which turns into the dry land (the loon is the only diver or the only successful one).

title_en: The duck is the successful diver
description_en: A duck or a similar water bird dives and brings a bit of earth which turns into the dry land (it is the only diver or the only successful one).

title_en: Earth taken from the belly of an invertebrate
description_en: The earth brought from the lower world proved to be in the belly of a worm or an insect, from which it was extracted.

title_en: A heap of earth rises above the water
description_en: Water is everywhere. Earth from the bottom is raked into a heap; its top rises above the water and turns into the dry land.

title_en: Bringing up the earth and the creation of man
description_en: In one and the same narrative the story of the creation of man and of an attempt to hinder it immediately follows the story of obtaining earth from the bottom of the sea or from the lower world.

title_en: The deity's antagonist brings the earth
description_en: An anthropomorphic deity sends his adversary to bring earth from the bottom. In the beginning the adversary or both persons sometimes have the guise of birds. After the adversary brings the earth, a confrontation begins between the two persons, who are now always anthropomorphic.
A lion (often a stone one) helps to survive the flood.
In the beginning of time or as a result of a catastrophe a brother and a sister are the only human couple. They marry and beget people.
In the beginning of time or after other people have perished a father and his daughter (daughters) remain. They marry, and people or particular ethnic groups descend from them.

title_en: After smallpox they did not recognize each other
description_en: A brother and a sister survived the flood. They married after they had smallpox and therefore did not recognize each other.

title_en: Rescue in a gourd during the flood
description_en: During the flood or in the beginning of time people (usually a brother and a sister) float in a big bottle gourd.

title_en: Rescue in a drum during the flood
description_en: During the flood a brother and a sister float in a drum.
God, an animal or a certain person warns one of the people about the coming catastrophe (usually the flood) in which most of the people perish.

title_en: The flood: people turn into aquatic animals
description_en: During a flood or when crossing a river those who drown or those who survive turn into aquatic or amphibious animals.
Two fires from different dwellings meet and talk.
A certain person possesses fire or steals it. His attention is attracted or diverted by singing, music, dancing, unusual gifts, obscene or strange behaviour, by an offer of sex, food and/or alcohol.
A small songbird (robin, kinglet, wren) obtains fire for people.
The spider possesses the first fire or steals it from its original owner (texts in which the spider acts together with other animals and does not play the main part are not included).
The shaman's drum is compared or associated with a lake.
Sacred knowledge, objects and rituals are obtained from the sky dwellers.
The bow of a canoe is made after the model of a bird's breastbone.
A son of the first human couple at first has the guise of a small plant, of a stalk that grew out of the ground.

title_en: Those who became fish turn into people again
description_en: People, or only women, go under the water and turn into fish. Men catch them with fishing tackle. Those who are fished out become people (women) again. (Narratives in which only one fished out fish turns into the hero's wife are not included; see motif F7).
A man makes or receives a figure of a woman. It becomes alive and becomes his wife.
Nails grow all the time, or the human body is covered with a hard layer only on the nails, because only the nails were washed with the water of life.

title_en: A female animal conceives from human urine
description_en: An animal (a snake, a pig) conceives from a man's urine and gives birth to a human child (or twins).

title_en: The smith kneads iron with his hands
description_en: A skilful smith has a special gift: he can take red-hot iron from the forge with his bare hands and knead it like dough giving it the shape he wants. Usually he breaks a certain taboo and loses his gift. (The motif was singled out and the data collected by Ruslan Doutaliev).
The first tongs were made after observing animals (crossed paws of a dog, two snakes, the jaws of a snake, etc.).
Women or people in general come out of fruits (often coconuts), or fruits or (more rarely) leaves turn into people or only into women. Cf. motif K33C.

title_en: A woman hides in a fruit
description_en: A woman hides inside a fruit brought into the house and comes out of it when nobody is around or when the fruit is cut open.

title_en: A woman hides in a wood chip
description_en: A woman hides inside a wood chip or a twig brought into the house and comes out of it when nobody is around.

title_en: The magic wife is a she-elephant
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his beloved (wife, helper) has the guise of a she-elephant (an elephant's tusk).

title_en: The magic wife is a swan
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his beloved (wife, helper) has the guise of a swan.

title_en: The magic wife is a duck
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his beloved (wife, helper, adopted daughter) has the guise of a duck.

title_en: The magic wife is a goose
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his beloved (wife, helper) has the guise of a goose.

title_en: The magic wife is a crane
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his beloved (wife, helper) has the guise of a crane.

title_en: The magic wife is a snail
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his wife has the guise of a snail.
People are believed to be descendants of monkeys.

title_en: The magic wife is a mouse
description_en: Before meeting the hero, his beloved (wife) has the guise of a mouse (rare: a rat).

title_en: The magic wife is a she-bear
description_en: A man marries a she-bear (a polar bear or a grizzly) who takes the guise of a woman, or a woman who takes the guise of a she-bear.

title_en: The magic wife is an aquatic mammal
description_en: A man marries a female seal or dolphin who has taken the guise of a woman and lives with her among people.

title_en: The magic wife is a frog or toad
description_en: A man marries a woman who has the guise of a frog or a toad.

title_en: A chaste woman revives a man
description_en: To revive a man or to extract an arrowhead (bullet) from his body, a chaste girl or woman must touch the killed or wounded man (step over him).
Thanks to her virtue a woman is able to do what others cannot, but she succeeds only after she recalls a trifling fault that she committed in her youth.
By means of magic a rival or the husband's mother tries to prevent a woman from giving birth to her child.
An anthropomorphic person comes into the world out of a stone.
After copulation a man and a woman are unable to break their embrace.
At first people copulated the way dogs do now, but later it became as it is now.
There is a separate penis-person with whom the first women, the amazons or just some woman copulate.
The owner of a field answers, deliberately or having misheard the question, that he is growing penises. After this penises grow in the field instead of cultivated plants.

title_en: Pleasant for the girl, dangerous for others
description_en: A girl (woman) possesses an object that is pleasant (useful). In somebody else's hands it proves to be harmful (dangerous).
Fruits or stalks of plants are penises.
A child deliberately comes out of his mother's womb not in the usual way but by making an opening in her body and often killing her. It is a sign of his malice and/or supernatural power.

title_en: The common husband of the first women
description_en: All women of the community of the first ancestors or all the amazons have a common lover of non-human nature, or they all mate at the same time with animals of a certain species which they summon with a signal.

A girl, a woman or a group of women willingly take for a lover a penis that exists as a separate being, a snake, a moray eel, a lizard, a worm, a crab, a big water animal or a water monster, or a big land mammal. People kill or maim the lover, the woman and/or her progeny, or the woman herself loses her human nature. The woman's behaviour is condemned.

Without knowing it, person eats or cooks the flesh of (slowly kills) a member of his household (a relative, rarely a servant or a spouse), or feeds it to his acquaintances, or uses his bones for household needs.
A man carries a child like a woman does.
A woman conceives from the wind against her will.
A woman gives birth to a son conceived from (a ray or the light of) the sun.
Not knowing who is before him, a youth kills his father.

title_en: To put on the naked body (demon and woman)
description_en: A demonic person makes a woman bare a certain part of her body because a certain object must be put only there. The demon kills the woman tearing out this part of her body. Usually the woman uses or names various places and the person rejects them one after another until the needed one is reached.

A girl or her father (rare: mother) picks a plant (usually a flower) and as a result encounters a person who has a non-human guise and/or lives in the lower world. The girl becomes the person's wife. In some cases the picked plant is the person's hair but more often there is no direct association of this kind.
Being in a deserted place, a person accidentally changes sex.

A strong female animal pursues a weak male but gets stuck between trees, stones, etc. The pursued one mocks his pursuer and usually rapes her. (In ATU motifs f83a and f83b are described as one tale type, ATU 36. How closely they are linked can be determined only with the original texts at hand.)

title_en: The serpent's wife and her children: transformation into birds
description_en: A serpent crawls onto the clothes of a bathing girl, gets off them for her promise to marry him and takes her to the underwater world. She is happy there and gives birth to children. Together with them she visits her relatives. The relatives call the serpent out of the water and kill him. After this the wife turns her children and/or herself into birds.

title_en: The serpent's wife and her children: transformation into trees
description_en: A serpent crawls onto the clothes of a bathing girl, gets off them for her promise to marry him and takes her to the underwater world. She is happy there and gives birth to children. Together with them she visits her relatives. The relatives call the serpent out of the water and kill him. After this the wife turns her children and/or herself into plants.
After a man performs a certain action, his penis begins to speak (often repeating what the man has said).

title_en: The talking penis and the mother-in-law
description_en: A man's penis begins to talk incessantly and falls silent only after his mother-in-law takes it in her hand.

The snake is to blame for others having eaten the food forbidden by the deity. For this it is deprived of the limbs it used to have. (The Efik version may be unrelated to the Biblical one, but the South Asian versions most probably are related.)

title_en: A dangerous animal in the vagina
description_en: A woman's vagina is dangerous because there is a toothed or stinging animal in it (and not just its mouth) or many such creatures.
On the wedding night the strong bride presses down on the bridegroom to crush him.
Before the appearance of cultivated plants people ate fungi. Beings of non-human nature feed on fungi. Fungi are false, inferior food.
Before cultivated or edible wild plants appeared, people ate what is now considered unfit for food: (rotten) wood, bark, earth, stones, mushrooms.
A person who embodies fertility and life first disappears and then (periodically) returns.
The first seeds (shoots, tubers) of cultivated plants or of the most important wild food plants and/or the knowledge of agriculture are brought from the sky (obtained from the sky dwellers).
Person steals cultivated plants for people hiding the seeds on or in his own body.
The first cereal grains were exposed to fire and scorched to a different degree. Hence the varieties of maize or rice that differ in the colour of their grains.

title_en: The big oak and its inhabitants
description_en: There is a unique tree that must be bent down or felled. Different creatures live in its different parts and/or objects of special importance are made of its wood.

title_en: The field turns into virgin land
description_en: A field tilled the day before turns into virgin land again by the morning.

title_en: Stop working, there will be a flood
description_en: A man clears a plot of vegetation but by the morning it is restored. At night a certain person tells trees and grass to rise and turns the tilled field into virgin land again. He explains that there will be a flood and working is senseless, and advises to prepare a vessel.

title_en: Orpheus: to bring back the dead wife
description_en: A husband follows his dead wife to the afterworld but cannot bring her back, or brings her back but loses her again.
Rivers (lakes) of blood (also of the water with which the dead were washed, of pus, bones, sweat) are mentioned in narratives (in different contexts). Cf. motifs H16, K33F, N34.
A body of milk (a river, a lake, a wave in the sea) that exists on earth (but not among the stars) is mentioned in narratives (in different contexts). Cf. motifs H16, K33F, N34.

title_en: The first dead opens the way for the rest
description_en: A certain person is the first to go to the world of the dead, after which all people follow the same way; he blazes the trail to the world of the dead; the first dead becomes the master or the guard of the afterworld.

title_en: People learn to bury the dead
description_en: People learn how to treat the dead by watching the behaviour of the raven.
Bringing embryos of people to our world, a person drops what he carries or opens it too early. (Sometimes this explains the inequality of people, the disorder in society).
A woman brought back from the other world or obtained there disappears when the man opens before the proper time the vessel in which she is.

title_en: Diseases and vermin from a hole in the ground
description_en: Vermin and insects crawl out and diseases come out of a hole made in the ground.
Hairs cut off an animal's hide or the ashes and smoke of a burnt hairy hide turn into bloodsucking insects.
Person creates bloodsucking insects to influence the behaviour of a marriage partner.
When the person who later became the dung beetle was told to pass certain instructions to people, he distorted them.

title_en: The dog appears at the moment of danger
description_en: At the moment when a dangerous creature attacks, a substance or an object thrown by chance turns into a dog that drives the attacker away.

title_en: The one spat upon is mortal
description_en: Man is mortal because he was spat upon when he was created.

title_en: The antagonist animates people instead of the creator
description_en: The creator made figures of people and went away for a while. Having got to the figures by deceit, the antagonist animates them himself. That is why people are mortal and imperfect.
A man enters into a relationship with a non-human being. When they part, the being tears (is going to tear) their child apart. (Most of the data were collected by S. Yu. Neklyudov).

title_en: Sky and Earth divide the children
description_en: Two persons, one related to the sky or water and the other to the earth, or to the world of spirits and the world of people, divide a child born to them or the people created by them. Usually Sky (Water, the spirit) takes the imperishable part and Earth (the human) the perishable one.

title_en: Death provokes one to touch the ground
description_en: Returning from the land of immortality, a man must not touch the ground. However, he dismounts to help an old man (old woman). Death, who has taken the guise of the old man, kills him at once. Rare: at the last moment the hero decides not to perform the actions that are fatal for him.
Having set out in search of a land where there is no death, a man meets persons engaged in tasks that can be completed only in a monstrously long time. But the man needs eternal life and he goes on.

title_en: The old man with a haircut
description_en: A man meets an old man whose face is completely covered with hair or snot. He cuts his hair (wipes his face) and is rewarded for this.
A person's glance brings death (and destruction).
A person's eyelids are propped open so that he cannot close them, or he does it himself on another's advice.

A person whose eyelids (eyelashes, eyebrows) are so heavy that he cannot open his eyes without help possesses enormous power and is dangerous for the hero and for people in general. He is often related to the lower world or to a past age.

From a man who has visited hell (met a deity) a robber learns about his future lot, humbly accepts the inevitability of retribution after death and is eventually saved. Usually the robber is contrasted with a self-confident righteous man who is punished for his pride.

title_en: Valuables in exchange for a cub
description_en: To obtain a desired object, person seizes the young or the female of a bird (snake, crayfish) and promises to let them go if the father bird (mother, male) brings what he wants.

title_en: The water of life in the land of darkness
description_en: At the edge of the world there is the land of darkness. Those who want to obtain the water of life or gold strive to get there.

title_en: The stork and the other world
description_en: Big birds that fly in a wedge (storks, cranes, swans, geese; German Zugvögel) are related to the other world (bring children from there, carry children away to the non-human world, possess the water of life and death, etc.).
Having received a magic bag into which any creature gets against its will at the owner's wish, a man gains power over Death or devils.
A man named Poverty makes Death swear never to come to him. That is why poverty in the world is everlasting.
A trickster first deceives Death (the devil) and then, also by deceit, gets into paradise.
Death devours the dead and thus satisfies its hunger.
The person who embodies death had a body visible to people. Later death became invisible.
A man sees a multitude of burning candles or lamps. When one of them burns out, one of the people dies.

title_en: Death is fairer and richer than God
description_en: A man (usually looking for a godfather for his newborn son) rejects God (saints) and the devil but praises Death: Death treats everybody without prejudice (or is richer than all).

title_en: Fleeing death from land to water
description_en: Knowing that Death is approaching, a man hopes that Death will look for him on land and therefore settles on the surface of the water or under water. But Death finds him.
Constellations are associated with agricultural implements or with people engaged in farm work (most often ploughing and haymaking). See motifs I110A (plough), I110B (haymaking).
A ram or a sheep with golden wool or the fleece of such a ram is described.
Beings shake the earth having learned that there are no more inhabitants on it, or checking whether they are still alive, or showing that they themselves are in place.

title_en: The earth rests on the back of a turtle (frog)
description_en: It is described how in the course of creation the obtained earth is put on the back of a turtle or a frog, which becomes its support.

title_en: Sky supports made of an animal's legs
description_en: The supports of the sky are made of the legs of a four-legged animal (usually a turtle).
Having entered the ear of an animal (usually a horse or a cow) and come out again, person becomes handsome (fed, dressed).

title_en: To take out of an animal's ear
description_en: Person takes food, clothes and other valuables out of the ear of an animal (most often a horse or a cow).
The sky (the Milky Way, clouds) is an animal hide or a piece of cloth.
A rolling wheel (and the person riding on it) is a being hostile to the hero (to people) or a weapon used by such a being.
One of the constellations is associated with a piece of footwear, usually with a (worn-out) bast shoe.
A glass mountain (tower, bridge) is mentioned as an unusual (hard to reach) place.

title_en: Throwing an axe back and forth
description_en: Two (more rarely three) men or women are at a distance from each other but regularly throw or pass something to each other. It is a sign of their unusual size, strength, dexterity.

A serpent agrees to let a man go on condition that he does not tell about their meeting. Under threat of death the man breaks his promise. The serpent teaches him how to drink the broth that will be made of the serpent's flesh and takes revenge not on the man but on those who made him break his word.
A rod thrown on the ground turns into a living snake.
A wand is a tool for performing actions whose results cannot be explained rationally.
Beings have no mouths. Usually mouths are then cut for them.
Beings without an anus or a mouth are dwarfs.

title_en: Dwarfs are inhabitants of the lower world
description_en: Dwarfs live in a world under the ground that partly resembles the world on earth. If dwarfs and people meet, the meeting takes place under the ground.

title_en: Dwarfs are inhabitants of rocks and hills
description_en: Dwarfs live not deep under the ground but inside hills, in stones, in mines, etc., and usually come out from there to the surface.

title_en: Dwarfs in a land on the horizon
description_en: The inhabitants of the land on the horizon (where the sky adjoins the earth) are dwarfs.

title_en: Birds perish at the border of our world
description_en: Some of the migratory birds (shamans in the guise of birds) perish at the border of our world.

title_en: A plank from the stern of the Argo
description_en: Person safely slips, sails or flies through an opening that snaps shut, but the edge of the stern of the boat, the tail of an animal or bird, the body of the mount, the hero's companion or his own heel is crushed, torn off, etc.

title_en: The water of life behind the clashing rocks
description_en: To obtain a magic reviving (healing) remedy, one must get into the space behind the clashing rocks.

title_en: Moving objects on the path of the dead
description_en: A dead person on the way to the afterworld must pass clashing rocks or other moving obstacles.
Person must pass small objects (trees, logs, blades) that constantly clash and part, fall and rise.
Mountains (stones) that constantly clash and part are mentioned, or a cleft or a maw in a vertical rock now opens and now closes. Cf. motif I22g1, "Colliding stones".
In the other world the hero sees many strange things, colliding stones among them (but they do not block his way).
Person must jump over a cleft (abyss) under his feet that now widens and now closes, or over a river whose banks come together and part.

title_en: A snake bridge to the other world
description_en: A body of water spanned by a snake bridge separates our world from another one.

title_en: To wipe the oven with one's hair
description_en: Women are mentioned who work without the simplest tools and use parts of their own bodies instead.
Women are mentioned who pull buckets of water out of a well using their own hair instead of a rope.
On the way to his goal person expresses feigned delight when meeting disgusting and dangerous objects and creatures and thus secures their loyalty (on his way back).
On the way to a dangerous person a man greases the gate (door hinges) with fat or oil. On his way back the grateful gate refuses to detain him.
There is a certain black or red dog that (is associated with objects of the night sky and) has a negative influence on people's lives.
During its afterlife journey the soul stops at a certain tree.
Person considers himself equal to a deity, imitating it, mocking it or trying to kill it.
One of the mythological persons, using the skills of a craft, is the first to make (usually to forge) tools and natural objects; he is the patron of craftsmen (usually smiths).
St Peter eats bread on the sly, and when Christ asks what he is doing, he chokes and spits out crumbs, which turn into mushrooms.

title_en: Souls of the dead walk along the rainbow
description_en: Souls of the dead walk along the rainbow to the other world; a rainbow bridge spans the river that separates the world of the dead from the world of the living.
During a thunderstorm a person strikes with a whip: these are the flashes of lightning.

title_en: The rainbow from an animal's mouth
description_en: The rainbow comes out of the mouth of a reptile, an amphibian or an invertebrate.

title_en: A celestial object is a snake's reflection
description_en: The rainbow or the Milky Way is a reflection of a snake (fish) that is on earth or in the sea.

title_en: Those who fell through the earth
description_en: The adversary of the hero of the narrative descends to the lower world.
An adversary steals the sinews (heart and eyes) of the thunder god, who gets them back and overcomes the adversary. Cf. motif L57A, "Hero's companion gets his body part back".
A hoofed animal with six or more legs is described or represented.
Person tears off a dog's legs one after another but the dog goes on doing what it considers necessary.
A predatory animal with six or more legs is described or depicted.

title_en: Sharabha (an animal with legs on its back)
description_en: An ungulate is described that has a second set of legs on its back and runs now in the usual way and now turned over on its back. This makes it tireless.
A big mammal supports the earth or is in the centre of the earth. See motif I8B.

title_en: A human is an evil spirit in the world of spirits
description_en: When a man who got to the other world touches its inhabitants, they fall ill or die.

title_en: Animal tracks on the Milky Way
description_en: The Milky Way is the track of animals that walked or ran.
Once a year water acquires unusual properties for a short time.
On a certain night of the year any wish that is uttered or conceived will come true. Cf. motif M13.
Stars are children of the moon and/or the sun.
A monster is beheaded or loses its body. Its head is depicted on temples and vessels (narrative texts and/or iconography).

title_en: Lightning is a crack in the sky
description_en: Lightning is a crack in the firmament through which the celestial vault is seen for a moment.
When a person in the upper world urinates, it rains (dew falls) on earth.

A man is allowed to control the weather in his own interests. He sends rain in due time but cannot take all the factors into account (usually forgets about the wind). The grain crop fails or is tasteless.
The Moon has two wives (usually the Morning Star and the Evening Star). With the caring one he grows fat, with the other he starves and grows thin.
In the sky there is a vessel, a box or a container, not described in detail, in which rain (rain clouds) is kept.

title_en: Hidden in the hollow of a tooth
description_en: A giant hides a pursued man in his mouth, usually (possibly always) in the hollow of a tooth; or the man remains alive in the giant's mouth having hidden in the hollow of a tooth. Cf. motif M21a.

title_en: The boaster meets the strongest one
description_en: When a person boasts of his strength, his wife or mother says that there is somebody stronger than he. He sets off to find him and meets a person who far surpasses him in strength. (ATU defines the tale type, or rather its first half, in a similar way, but some of the references given there relate to our motif I87A and not to I87B).

title_en: A little mouse in a boat
description_en: A mouse makes itself a boat of a small object.
After the present people dwarfs will live on earth.
Before the present people others lived who were distinguished by their strength, stature, nobility or other qualities. They disappeared after they had committed suicide.
Four anthropomorphic male persons support the sky or the earth or are placed at the four cardinal points.
Four objects or beings (or four groups of beings, or four at the corners and the fifth in the centre) support the sky or the earth or are placed at the four cardinal points. See motifs 8A, 8D.
Person goes to his goal following a rolling ball of thread (more rarely an apple, a ball).
A person who jumps or steps over the rainbow changes sex.
There is a treasure where the ends of the rainbow reach the ground.
The rainbow is a hoofed animal (horse, bull, goat, sheep).

title_en: The Pleiades are a flock of birds
description_en: The Pleiades are a small flock of (flying) birds.
The zenith and/or the nadir are regarded together with the four cardinal points as one more (or two more) principal directions.
Persons take revenge for the death of their father, mother or other relatives who are one generation (more rarely two generations) older than they.

title_en: To put food on the abdomen
description_en: When a woman remains alone, a demonic person comes to her. He says that to do certain things she must put a certain part of her body at his disposal, though this is against logic and custom. After this the person kills her (rips her belly open; tears out her tongue).
A demonic person comes to a woman and tears out her tongue. She dies (and revives when the tongue is found and returned).
Gods, ancestors of people, founders of dynasties are born from eggs.

To overcome a monster, a youth (twins) prepares spears in advance and leaves them along the supposed route of his retreat. Running away from the monster, the youth throws the spears at it one after another and eventually kills it.

title_en: The youngest brother defeats the monster
description_en: People in general or elder brothers (siblings, an elder sister) disappear one after another. A woman brings up a boy from infancy or, left alone, conceives a son in a miraculous way or finds a baby. He overcomes the antagonists and usually revives or frees those who disappeared.

title_en: The late twins defeat the monster
description_en: People in general or elder brothers (siblings, an elder sister) disappear one after another. A woman brings up two twins (or several children) from infancy. They overcome the antagonists and usually revive or free those who disappeared.
To make sure that the adversary is really dead, an insect or a bird gets inside his body at one end and comes out at the other.

title_en: A child born in the grave saves the mother
description_en: A woman dies but her body does not decay and she gives birth to a child in the grave. The child is found and brings the mother back to life.
A she-wolf suckles an abandoned baby. He becomes an outstanding leader.

Among the children of a woman or of two women living together there are a boy and a puppy, or the woman's son was thrown away and a puppy left in his place. The puppy lives with the woman and helps her.
At night somebody tramples a field, steals hay, etc. The hero finds out that horses do it.

title_en: A demon comes to harm the deceased
description_en: At night a demonic person comes to the grave of a dead man intending to harm him.

The girl will be given to the one who on horseback or in some other way quickly reaches a place that is hard to reach (the top of a tower or a mountain, the upper floor of a palace, the upper steps of a staircase, a bridge, the bottom of a chasm, jumps over a moat, etc.). Usually the girl herself is at the place to which the suitor must ascend or (rarely) descend. In the Italian versions the hero wins tournaments.
Every time a mare foals, the foal is stolen. The hero finds out who does it.
Keeping watch, the hero finds out who steals fruits (usually apples) from the garden.

title_en: Revenge for the death of male relatives
description_en: Heroes avenge the death (taking into slavery) of their father, uncles, grandfather, or of both mother and father, or of their elder kin in general, the loss of the men being the most painful.

title_en: Throws up a mace and offers his forehead
description_en: A strong man orders an iron mace (sword, etc.) of monstrous size to be made but breaks it and demands a new one, still heavier (often he throws it up into the air and puts his forehead, etc., under it, and the mace breaks).

title_en: Goats are the owners of food
description_en: Person gets into a house where goats live. He secretly eats the food he finds there but is eventually discovered.
When a person runs away from a pursuer, a strong rope (chain, etc.) is let down (thrown) to him. A rotten rope is let down to the pursuer; it breaks and the pursuer falls to his death (drowns).
A woman is killed. Her son or children (rare: grandchildren, nephews) avenge her.
Children (a son, sons, a son and a daughter) of a murdered man or woman take revenge on persons who are related to the victim by marriage or close kinship.

title_en: A cut-off finger instead of a chicken bone
description_en: A girl must get into an inaccessible place with the help of chicken bones. She loses one or there are not enough bones. Having cut off her finger and using it the way she was to use the bones, the girl reaches her goal.
A person invites another to play. The latter follows the rules, and the one who started the game does not and kills the other.

title_en: A way of revenge: to lure into smoke and fire
description_en: Children of a murdered person kill the children of the murderer having lured them to a place where they die of heat or smoke.

title_en: The breasts of the killed mother
description_en: Two women live together, both have children. One of them goes out with the other, kills her, brings her flesh home and begins to cook it. The children of the dead woman notice their mother's breasts (in California: eyes or liver), or the mother's breasts themselves speak to her children.

title_en: One of two friends kills the other
description_en: Two women live together, both have children. One of them goes out with the other, kills and (later) eats her. The children of the murdered woman escape. See motif J52.
Two women live together, both have children. One of them kills and (then) eats the other. The killer is associated with a grizzly she-bear and the victim with a she-bear of a smaller species.

The heroes of the narrative exterminate animals or demons of a certain kind. This kind could have disappeared altogether if one or several individuals (often a pregnant female) had not escaped. (The motif does not include etiological endings according to which the present creatures of a certain kind originate from a dismembered primeval creature).
To cross a river, each of three men uses his own magic way.
A chain of arrows forms a bridge across a body of water.

title_en: To revive the dead with a lash of the whip
description_en: Person strikes the remains of a dead one with a lash or a whip and the dead one revives.

title_en: To revive the dead by stepping over the bones
description_en: Person steps or jumps over the remains of a killed one and the killed one revives.

title_en: The mistress of the island turns men into animals
description_en: A sorceress who lives on an island turns men into animals.

title_en: A sister asks her brother to obtain the impossible
description_en: To destroy a youth, a female antagonist makes his sister (rare: the youth himself) desire magic objects, and an attempt to get them is deadly dangerous. The youth sets off to obtain the objects.

title_en: Killings in jest and in earnest
description_en: A man is killed (with a blade, with the water of death) and then revived. Another asks to have the same done to him but is not revived.

title_en: To carry lunch to the father
description_en: A girl (more rarely a boy) carries lunch to her father or brothers who work in the field (in the forest) but gets to a demonic person.
A monstrous bird (bat) attacks people and heroes fight it. See motifs K10A – K10G.

title_en: Having quenched his thirst, he breaks the chains
description_en: A captive supernatural person breaks his fetters and gets free after he is given water (or wine, etc.) to drink.

A supernatural person fulfils the wishes of one or several people and later visits them again. The one who was favoured, or most of them, prove ungrateful and drive him away. In response the person deprives them of what they received.

title_en: The strongman is drugged and immobilized
description_en: A mighty person loses his strength (control over himself) after he is made drunk, and then admits that drink is stronger than he. (See Neklyudov 2025a; 2025b).

An enchanted person (the castle where the action takes place) gradually changes appearance in the course of several days as the spell wears off: acquires human features, turns from black to white, from ugly to beautiful.

title_en: The hero’s woman helps his enemy
description_en: A woman who initially is a friend of the hero (his sister, mother, more rarely wife or beloved) later tries to destroy him acting together with his adversary. For this she induces the hero to do things that are fatal for him.

title_en: Conflict of a son with his mother
description_en: A mother seeks to destroy her son (children) because he is an obstacle to her love affair. Cf. motif L86: Children flee from the demon mother.
Somebody (usually a woman) puts a poisonous tooth (bone, nail, etc.) into the hero's bed. The youth dies but is then revived.
A person hostile to a youth is on the other side of a body of water. The youth's sister or mother helps that person to cross and becomes his lover.

title_en: To fill a vessel with tears
description_en: A woman must fill one or two vessels with tears (more rarely with blood). Usually after this the term of her punishment is to end, or the punishment depends on which of the vessels contains more tears.

title_en: Changing his shape, the hero regains the magic object
description_en: An adversary gets hold of the object that makes the hero invulnerable and kills him. The hero is revived. Having changed his shape, he provokes the adversary to put the magic object on the ground, gets hold of it again and kills the adversary.

title_en: A wood chip turns into a duck
description_en: An adversary destroys one after another the objects and creatures into which the hero is reincarnated. The hero wins after he turns from a wood chip into a water bird (duck, goose).
A tree that has suddenly grown lets only the heroine use its fruits and moves after her when she moves to a new place.
A cow (goat) spins or weaves in a miraculous way: chews tow turning it into thread, tells to wind the yarn on its horns, to put it into its ear, etc.

title_en: The helpful bull fights in the copper forest
description_en: Sitting on a bull or an ox, a youth or a girl runs away from the stepmother's house. On the way the bull fights other bulls (monsters), and the last of them most often kills it.

title_en: To enter the horse's ear and take things out of the cow's ear
description_en: An animal (rarely a demonic being) tells the hero or the heroine to take the objects they need out of its ear or to enter its ear in order to be transformed, to fall asleep, etc.

title_en: The head of the house brings the promised gifts
description_en: When the head of the house leaves on business, those who stay ask him to bring them gifts. The elder ones ask for something of obvious value (usually clothes and jewellery), and the youngest daughter or son for something unusual and at first sight of little value (a flower, a bird, etc.). As a result it is the youngest who, having passed trials, succeeds in life.

title_en: A shepherdess instead of the princess
description_en: A nobleman (king) is forced to promise his daughter or son to a demon (monster, beast of prey). He tries to substitute other girls or youths for her or him but fails.

When the father leaves, his daughter asks him to bring her a flower (leaf, etc.). The father picks it in the garden of an enchanted prince who has a monstrous guise. The monster demands the daughter from the father and, thanks to the girl, regains the shape of a prince.

title_en: A daughter asks for a magic bridegroom
description_en: When the father leaves, his daughter asks him to bring her an object or a creature in which a magic bridegroom is embodied. The father does not understand the meaning of the request.

title_en: Trying to wake the wonderful spouse
description_en: Having overcome difficulties, a girl (rarely a youth) finds her magic husband (his magic wife) but at first cannot wake him (her).

title_en: The magic wife cannot wake the youth
description_en: Waiting for his magic wife, a youth falls asleep. The wife cannot wake him and leaves (the episode is often repeated).
A woman remains pregnant for many years and gives birth only after the wonderful husband who left her or somebody else allows her to do it.
When the magic husband leaves his earthly wife, his shirt gets stained with blood. Only the wife, when she comes, manages to wash it clean.

title_en: The monstrous bird's eyes: a metamorphosis
description_en: Brothers (a brother and a sister) kill a monstrous bird. Its eyes turn into celestial luminaries (among the Indians of Oaxaca) or into something else (into the present condors among the Yokuts).

title_en: The frog princess is the mistress of the thunderstorm
description_en: The youngest prince marries a frog. She is to come to his parents for the first time. A thunderstorm begins. Rain, lightning and thunder mean that the prince's wife is washing, dressing, riding, etc.

title_en: The father is persuaded to leave his daughter in a chest
description_en: To get hold of a girl, a cleric arranges it so that her father agrees to put her into a chest (barrel) and set it adrift in the river (leave it in a deserted place).
A man sentenced to death asks to be given for the last time something of his belongings, usually a musical instrument. Having received it, he gains power over those present and escapes.

title_en: Two in bed with the princess
description_en: A princess lying between two suitors must blindly choose the one she likes better. The suitor of low birth arranges it so that his noble rival stinks (and he himself smells sweet). The princess turns to him.

title_en: The portrait of an unknown beauty
description_en: Having seen the portrait of a beauty, a man strives to meet her.
The antagonist believes that the lord of the thunderstorm has attacked him (it is the father of the bride whom the zoomorphic helper obtained by deceit for a poor youth, motif K119).
A cat helps a poor youth to marry a princess (a girl to marry a prince).
The poor youth whom the animal helper favoured by presenting him to the king as a rich man is a miller or a miller's son.

title_en: Birds originate from the monster bird
description_en: Pieces of flesh or feathers of a monstrous or unusual bird turn into the present birds (or into their plumage).

title_en: To lure a woman onto a ship
description_en: To get a woman, a man lures her onto a ship (into a boat, a flying machine, etc.) and takes her away.

title_en: The brothers are turned into bulls
description_en: A group of brothers is turned into bulls (oxen) and then disenchanted.

title_en: The best apples for the princess
description_en: Each of three brothers carries fruits (rarely fish, etc.) as a present for a princess (a prince) and meets a person who punishes rudeness and rewards politeness. As a result (after additional trials) the youngest brother makes the desired marriage.

A ruler will give his daughter to the one who can herd without losses (gather, train) hares (squirrels, sheep, poultry, partridges). A poor youth fulfils the task with the help of a magic means. To have a pretext for refusal, members of the ruler's family try to buy one hare (the magic pipe, etc.) so that the suitor could not keep his promise, but as a result find themselves in a humiliating position.

title_en: The sorceress's husband breaks a taboo
description_en: The hero gets into a world beyond the world of people and marries there. His wife allows him to visit his former world but on a certain condition. The hero breaks it, which causes (irreparable) misfortunes. Cf. motif F94 (the hero is unfaithful to his magic wife in her world); K25a6 (the hero visits his world together with his magic wife).

title_en: The abducted woman escapes while the archers compete
description_en: A woman suggests that her abductors shoot arrows: she will marry the winner. While they are finding out whose arrow flew farther, the abducted woman runs away.
Footwear is mentioned in which a person quickly covers enormous distances.

title_en: The coward put out of the door
description_en: A coward or an idler has so wearied his household that they leave him outside. He sets off and overcomes mighty adversaries by chance or by cunning.
Having seen a youth's hair carried away by the water, a woman decides to make its owner her husband.
From a cow (buffalo) a youth receives two flutes (pipes, horns), and playing them produces different effects (joy and sorrow, well-being and a call for help, etc.).

title_en: A girl in the guise of a youth gets a wife for her brother
description_en: A brother is killed. His sister in his clothes wins a woman. The brother revives, the sister puts on female clothes again, and the woman believes that the girl's brother was the one who married her.

title_en: The image of a predator kills
description_en: A man is foretold death from an animal. An image of the animal that came to life, or a statue in the shape of the animal that fell on him, kills (tries to kill) him.
After a man and a girl are left alone (usually on the wedding night), the girl turns into a predator or a monster and eats the man.
A man who went away to earn money sends his wife a pomegranate, unaware of its value. The wife finds treasure in the pomegranate.

title_en: The devil and the wife in the pit
description_en: A man rescues a devil (snake, predator) who suffers from the closeness of a certain person or object. To reward his rescuer, the devil promises to possess a princess and to leave her when the man comes to cure her. The devil either breaks his promise or warns the man not to try to cure those whom he will possess later. The man tells the devil that the person or object he is mortally afraid of is approaching again. The devil takes to flight and never comes back.

title_en: The prince grew up in seclusion
description_en: A man (usually a king) brings up his son (daughter) in isolation. Once (usually by chance) the youth (girl) sees the outside world and comes out of confinement.

A man (usually a king) brings up his daughter (more rarely son) in a closed room and orders to feed her with boneless meat. Once there is a bone in the meat; the girl (youth) makes a hole in the wall with it and sees the outside world for the first time.

title_en: The girl's hair serves as a rope to climb up
description_en: A girl lets down her hair and another person climbs up it to her.
A father regularly weighs his daughter and learns about her pregnancy when she becomes heavier.
People suspect that a youth is a girl in disguise. Tests are proposed to establish it, but the girl manages to avoid exposure (for a long time).

title_en: A dog helps the girl to remain unrecognized
description_en: People suspect that a youth is a girl in disguise. She manages to avoid exposure thanks to her dog (rare: cat), which learns about the ways of determining its mistress's true sex and tells her about them.

title_en: The demon's answers to his wife's questions
description_en: A woman who lives in the house of a supernatural person hides a man who has come to her and asks the person the questions whose answers the man must learn.
A group of girls forms a community or a band and acts independently of men. Cf. motif F39.
A boy plays pretending to be a king and showing wisdom and/or magic abilities.

title_en: The prince and the smith's son
description_en: A queen conceives a hatred for the son she is pregnant with and replaces him with the son (rarely daughter) of a common man, who brings up the prince. The prince shows wisdom and becomes king.

title_en: What kind of lamb is in the ewe's womb
description_en: A boy is able to tell the sex and the colour of the young in an animal's womb.

title_en: An imaginary life in an instant
description_en: A man lives through a long and eventful period of life. Everything proves to be an illusion: he is again at the same place and at the same moment at which the story began.

title_en: Food turns into severed body parts
description_en: A man thinks that he is holding something meant to be eaten (a calf's head, a melon, bread, etc.), but these objects turn into human heads or limbs. Cf. motif K80c1.

title_en: The bewitched one became a bear
description_en: A man makes another believe that he has become a bear (wolf), has found himself in a forest, etc. Having come to his senses, the bewitched one finds himself where he was.
A hunter spares the animal he is chasing having noticed that it is a pregnant female and remembered his own pregnant wife.

title_en: Water without frogs, land without flies
description_en: Person sets off in search of a place where there are no ordinary creatures that live everywhere (water without frogs, air without flies).
Heroes fight but the enemies do not grow fewer because somebody continuously weaves (forges) new warriors.

title_en: The deaf bride without hands and feet
description_en: A man describes his daughter to a prospective bridegroom as ugly and crippled. The bridegroom agrees to marry her and the bride proves to be a beauty.
A powerful and rich man loses everything and is separated from his wife and children, who are separated from each other. The man regains power and wealth and the family is reunited.

To give a sign of his arrival, a person puts or, more often, secretly drops into the jug of a maidservant or a servant a ring or another small personal ornament or toilet article. Having found it, another person understands that the first one is nearby.

title_en: The wind carried off the flour
description_en: A man was carrying flour and a rising wind blew it away. The man complains to a powerful person and usually receives compensation. Cf. motif M57d3 ("Wind grants a wish").

title_en: A man in search of a woman
description_en: A man sets off to find or bring back his bride or wife.
The hero looks for his magic wife who has left him. It turns out that one of the winds is just flying to her to do a certain job for her. The hero goes along with it.
A girl or a woman sets off to find or bring back her bridegroom or husband, or flees from danger, and her wandering ends in a successful marriage.

title_en: The enchanted husband drives away and finds his wife again
description_en: A girl descends to the lower world to her magic husband, and when she breaks a taboo he drives her away (sends her off on an errand). She comes to live with other people and has a child by her magic husband. The husband finds her, the spouses are reunited and the spell is broken. (The motif is being worked on.)

title_en: As much gold as the bride weighs
description_en: For an object (usually a girl) as much gold (silver) as it weighs itself (or more) is given or promised, or a heap of valuables as high as the one who is being bought.

title_en: The time of the wolf and the time of the fox
description_en: A ruler demands that his dream be explained. A snake tells a man that the dream means the coming of a time when people tend to behave in a certain way. This happens several times. Each time the man confirms the snake's words by his behaviour towards it.
The hero finds a horse that suits him in an underground chamber (in a cellar, in an empty castle, in deep mud, etc.) where it has stood for many years.

title_en: To put a hand on the horse's back
description_en: When a man puts his hand on a horse's back, the horse bends or falls. It is a sign of heroic strength.
A supernatural protector comes to help when he hears an alarm signal but stops doing so after the signal was given in vain.
A mighty hero who is in a cave (in a crypt, etc.) will come out some day (to help his people), or he could come out but decides not to.

title_en: In which fish is the swallowed one?
description_en: Person rips open the bellies of water creatures (carrion birds) or looks into their throats to find the swallowed one or a part of his body.

title_en: When the forest starts to move
description_en: Person links the coming of an event that he considers impossible with the time when the trees of the forest start to move like people.

title_en: The combat of father and son
description_en: Not recognizing his son, a father fights a duel with him and kills him.

A girl becomes pregnant without knowing it through contact with bodily secretions of a male person or with objects that he touched (i.e. not as a result of intercourse, not by a mere wish of the father of her future child and not through a mystical contact with a deity). The story ends with the happy union of the girl and the father of her child.

title_en: Having got to the sky, she marries there
description_en: A girl gets to the sky and marries there.

title_en: A woman returns from the sky
description_en: A sky dweller marries an earthly woman. She longs to return to earth and descends in secret from her husband.

title_en: An old man helps to get a bird wife
description_en: A youth comes to an old man (more rarely an old woman) who teaches him how to get a magic wife by hiding her bird garment. Usually the first time the youth gives the garment back and lives with the old man until the girls come flying again.
A man deliberately takes for a wife a woman who belongs to the non-human world.

title_en: Rescue from the underwater world (the cut chain)
description_en: A young woman is in the power of a water dweller, and when she comes out on land she is fastened with a chain. To free the woman, the chain must be cut.

title_en: The magic wife does not forgive infidelity
description_en: A woman from another world agrees to live with a man in his earthly world but leaves him after learning that he has broken a taboo (often that he has been unfaithful). Cf. motif F94 (the hero is unfaithful to his magic wife in her world); motif K12B (the hero visits his world alone, contrary to the warning of his magic wife).

title_en: Two brothers and the winged maiden
description_en: The elder brother hunts, the younger keeps house. Having caught a winged maiden, the elder marries her, and the younger naively gives her wings back to her. The elder sets off in search of his wife.

title_en: The magic wife is an ancestor of people
description_en: People in general or a particular ethnic, kin or social group are considered descendants of an earthly man and a woman of supernatural origin.

A girl demands that her suitor get a pair of shoes (or other objects) just like hers. These objects either exist in a single copy or nobody knows what they look like. Having become invisible, the hero either steals the objects (and the owner has to make new ones herself) or finds out what they look like.

title_en: To fill a featherbed with feathers
description_en: Person must quickly obtain enough feathers to stuff a featherbed or a pillow.
Person must build a house of bird feathers or cover a roof, a bridge, etc. with feathers.
To fell all the trees of a forest, a man fells one (touching it lightly with his axe), after which all the trees fall.

title_en: To sow, reap and bake bread in one day
description_en: Person must carry out all the field work in an unthinkably short time and present the products of the new harvest.
A man tries or has to try to chop or dig with a wooden (lead, felt) tool instead of a steel one. Cf. motif L84.
Person is told to bring fruits of a tree that is hard to reach.

title_en: The task-giver is a family member
The hero struggles with the elements
description_en: In the course of his wooing the hero fights persons (more than two) who embody the elements, luminaries, parts of the universe.

title_en: The hero's adversaries are polar bears
description_en: Difficult tasks and trials are set for the hero by the inhabitants of the village of polar bears, his wife's relatives.

title_en: The adversary is a bear father-in-law
description_en: Difficult tasks and trials are set for the hero by his bear father-in-law.

title_en: The ball is a human head
description_en: Severed human heads are compared to balls. Or a person plays with a severed human head or a skull as with a ball.

title_en: To play with a dangerous ball
description_en: To destroy the hero, his adversaries play ball with him throwing a heavy dangerous object (a ball of ice, bone, stone, iron, a walrus head, a biting skull, etc.).

Two groups of persons compete in passing trials or play a game divided into two teams (no less than two episodes with different persons on both sides). The participants are either anthropomorphic but possess different unusual abilities, or they are different animals (natural phenomena, elements, etc.). Cf. motif K27xy (Persons with different properties in the enemy camp).

title_en: The hostile father-in-law takes the shape of a bear
description_en: Having demanded that the hero kill a bear, the father-in-law (rare: mother-in-law) himself takes the shape of a bear or turns his daughter or wife (husband) into a bear.

title_en: Lioness's milk in a lion cub's skin
description_en: The hero is sent to bring the milk of a lioness in a skin bag made of a lion's hide (usually of the hide of the lioness's cub).
The hero is sent to obtain a musical instrument, usually a self-playing gusli (psaltery).
The antagonist believes that the hero was burned but returned safely from the other world, and therefore orders himself or his representative to be burned.
The task: to bring objects (fruits, a tree, water, etc.) that perform actions typical of humans (sing, dance, yawn, laugh, etc.).

When the husband sets off to fulfil a difficult task, his magic wife gives him her towel or kerchief and tells him to use only them (usually so that her relatives would recognize him as their son-in-law).

Setting off in search of a woman or of magic objects, a man comes in succession to persons of non-human (often demonic) nature who help him. The persons are of the same kind but usually each next one is older (younger) than the previous.

title_en: Luminaries and the wind direct the hero
description_en: Having set off in search of a marriage partner, the hero or the heroine comes in succession to the embodiments (masters) of luminaries and atmospheric phenomena (the sun, the moon, stars, the wind).

title_en: A person comes to the sun's mother
description_en: Person comes to the mother of the Sun when the Sun himself is not there. Cf. motif B33h ("The sun's mother").

title_en: The master of animals summons and questions them
description_en: On the way to his goal a man meets persons who have power over animals (birds, fish) or demons. They summon the animals (demons) and ask whether anybody knows the way to a certain place. Only one knows, usually the one who came last.
Only the frog (toad) knows the way to the object which the hero seeks and which ordinary people cannot reach (and helps him to get there).

title_en: To get an object from the bottom of the sea
description_en: The hero must get a small object (often a ring) thrown into a deep body of water (often into the sea). Cf. motif C6 ("The diver").

title_en: Persons with different properties in the enemy camp
description_en: Several men (animal persons), each of whom can do something better than the others, together fulfil difficult tasks set for them by their adversaries. The contest is not aimed at finding a bridegroom worthy of the girl or at getting rid of an unwanted suitor. Cf. motif K27o3 (A contest of two teams).
The hero is sent to a tree that is to fall on him.

title_en: To get a feather of a dangerous bird
description_en: The hero brings a feather (feathers) of a dangerous bird.

title_en: To get a nestling of a dangerous bird
description_en: The hero is sent to bring a nestling of a dangerous bird.

title_en: To get fruits of a dangerous tree
description_en: The hero must bring fruits that grow on a tree which is dangerous to approach.

title_en: To get the bark of a tree
description_en: The hero must get the bark of a tree, which involves danger.

title_en: An innocent woman accused of lewdness
description_en: Having noticed a woman's pregnancy, her relatives or in-laws accuse her of lewdness because, by their reckoning, she could not have conceived from her husband or bridegroom. After hard trials the woman meets again the father of the boy she gave birth to.

title_en: The unrecognized wife visits her husband
description_en: A husband leaves his wife without having consummated the marriage. The wife visits her husband incognito and eventually he understands who is with him. Usually the wife spends a night with her husband, gives birth to a son (three children) and the husband becomes convinced that the son is his.

A poor girl buys a doll (goose) that defecates gold. When the neighbours take the doll, it only soils their house. It is thrown out; a prince uses it to wipe himself and it sticks to his buttocks. Nobody can help, but the poor girl does it easily. The prince marries her.

title_en: He who learns the family secret will die
description_en: A man is going to kill the one who has learned why he cruelly punished his former wife.

A youth (girl) lives in the house of an ogress (witch). To destroy him or her, the ogress tells him or her to bring a certain object from other ogres (often from her mother or sister). The hero or the heroine escapes (and destroys all the ogres).

title_en: The pit by the apple tree
description_en: A father or a (werewolf) stepmother pushes or shuts sisters (a girl and her maidservants) into a pit. The heroine manages to get out and triumphs over her female antagonists.

title_en: The wife who must not be beaten
description_en: A presumptuous prince (merchant's son) beats his wife every day (marries on condition that he will beat his wife every day). She rescues him, demonstrating her superiority.

title_en: A commoner sees the princess being abducted
description_en: A demon carries away a girl of noble birth. A common man accidentally witnesses the abduction or accidentally finds evidence of it. The girl's father sends him to search for his daughter.

title_en: The abducted princess drops a slipper
description_en: A monster carrying away a princess rushes past a youth. The youth picks up a slipper lost by the princess or, having shot, finds a lock of her hair. He sets off in search of her, descends under the ground and rescues her.

title_en: The hero is left on the mountain
description_en: The hero's companions leave him on a mountain having destroyed the rope (chain) by which he climbed there or which he let down.

The occupations or only the names of the hero's companions are unusual and different for each of them, but their specific abilities, which these names imply, are of no importance for the development of the plot. Cf. motif K66, "Extraordinary companions".

title_en: Went for a walk and vanished
description_en: A woman or a girl is forbidden to go outside. As soon as she does it, a flying creature abducts her.
A man's mother takes the appearance of his wife to take her place.

title_en: The daughter's flesh is sent to her mother
description_en: A powerful person marries; a wicked woman replaces his bride with her own daughter. After the false wife is exposed and executed, the woman receives cooked meat as a gift and does not understand at once that these are parts of her daughter's body.

title_en: What does the one who did this deserve?
description_en: A villain is asked what punishment the one who committed such a crime deserves. Not knowing that he himself is meant, he determines the way of his own execution.

title_en: Left for the ants to eat
description_en: A man executes his wife leaving her to be eaten by ants.
The antagonist is executed by being burned alive. (Episodes in which burning a person is not a punishment but a means of getting rid of him are not counted).

title_en: The false wife is an insect or larva

description_en: A ruler distributes horses (cows) among his subjects for fattening. Only the heroine returns hers well-fed.

title_en: The heroine is turned into an animal (not drowned)
description_en: To take the heroine's place, her rival turns her into an animal or a bird and does not push her into the water. Cf. motif K33.

title_en: The heroine is turned into an animal (not drowned)
The heroine in the whale's belly
description_en: A woman thrown into the water finds herself in the belly of a fish (whale) but is later rescued.

title_en: The witch distorts what was said
description_en: A brother takes his sister to her bridegroom. She cannot make out her brother's words herself, and a witch distorts them (as if the brother tells his sister to throw herself into the water, tells to blind her, etc.). Having got rid of the heroine, the witch replaces her with her own daughter.

title_en: The heroine is turned into a turtle
description_en: A woman turned into a turtle through the intrigues of her rival tries to get in touch with her children or her husband.

title_en: The heroine is turned into a forest animal
description_en: A woman turned through the intrigues of her rival into a medium-sized forest animal (lynx, she-wolf, reindeer doe) tries to get in touch with her children or her husband.

title_en: The heroine is turned into a duck
description_en: A woman who became a duck (goose) through the intrigues of her rival tries to get in touch with her children or her husband.

title_en: Knives are being sharpened, cauldrons are boiling
description_en: A kid (lamb, gazelle, etc.) runs up to the body of water into which its mistress was pushed and says that knives are already being sharpened and water boiled to slaughter and cook it.

title_en: The widower, his daughter (son) and the teacher
